_note: The remedy ladder. For each domain, the statutory or regulatory remedy the citizen actually holds — with its forum, its clock and its teeth. Naming a remedy is NOT legal advice; every surface that shows one must say so.
_disclaimer: This names an option and cites the provision. It is not legal advice.

bank.rbi_ombudsman.title: RBI Ombudsman
bank.rbi_ombudsman.teeth: Award up to ₹20 lakh, plus up to ₹1 lakh for time, expense and harassment
bank.rbi_ombudsman.clock: Available once your bank has had 30 days
bank.rbi_ombudsman.before_gate: Your bank has to be given 30 days first. We will file with the bank now and tell you the day the ombudsman becomes available.
bank.rbi_ombudsman.after_gate: Your bank has had {days} days. That means the RBI Ombudsman can hear this, and can award up to ₹20 lakh.

tax.244a.title: Interest you are owed on a late refund
tax.244a.where: Claimed through the assessing officer / CPC
tax.244a.teeth: 0.5% per month or part of a month
tax.244a.clock: Accrues while the delay is not your fault
tax.244a.after_gate: Interest under Section 244A is statutory, not discretionary. If the delay is not your fault, it is owed to you at 0.5% for every month.

pf.ombudsman.title: Taking your PF case higher, up to the Ombudsman
pf.ombudsman.forum: The Regional PF Commissioner first, then the Central PF Commissioner, then the EPF Ombudsman for your area
pf.ombudsman.teeth: An appeal the law gives you under section 7I. The Ombudsman can order the office to act
pf.ombudsman.clock: Ombudsman route opens roughly a month after EPFiGMS fails
pf.ombudsman.before_gate: EPFiGMS gets the first attempt. We will file there and tell you when the Ombudsman route opens.
pf.ombudsman.after_gate: EPFiGMS has had {days} days. The EPF Ombudsman for your region can take this, and there is a statutory appeal under section 7I.

ration.nfsa.title: District Grievance Redressal Officer
ration.nfsa.forum: Every district has one under the National Food Security Act
ration.nfsa.where: District Grievance Redressal Officer, then the State Food Commission on appeal
ration.nfsa.teeth: Something the law owes you, not a favour you are asking for
ration.nfsa.clock: No 21-day cap — this is a right, not a grievance
ration.nfsa.after_gate: Ration is a statutory entitlement. Your district has a Grievance Redressal Officer under NFSA section 15, and the State Food Commission hears appeals under section 16.

electricity.cgrf.title: Consumer Grievance Redressal Forum
electricity.cgrf.forum: CGRF of your distribution company, then the Electricity Ombudsman
electricity.cgrf.where: CGRF, then the state Electricity Ombudsman
electricity.cgrf.teeth: The Forum must decide in 3 months; the Ombudsman in about 60 days
electricity.cgrf.clock: Appeal to the Ombudsman within 30 days of the Forum's order
electricity.cgrf.after_gate: Your distribution company has a Consumer Grievance Redressal Forum under section 42(5) that must decide within three months, and an Electricity Ombudsman above it under section 42(6).

housing.rera.title: RERA Authority
housing.rera.forum: State Real Estate Regulatory Authority and its Adjudicating Officer
housing.rera.teeth: They can be made to pay you compensation, interest and a penalty. Above that sits the Appellate Tribunal
housing.rera.clock: Authority disposes in 60 days; appeal within 60 days; tribunal in 60 days
housing.rera.after_gate: A builder delay is a RERA matter. The Authority must dispose of it in 60 days, and its Adjudicating Officer can award you compensation and interest.

mgnrega.ombudsperson.title: District Ombudsperson
mgnrega.ombudsperson.teeth: Can investigate and order payment. If wages are more than 15 days late you are owed compensation. If no work was given, you are owed 25% of the minimum wage for the first 30 days and half the wage after that
mgnrega.ombudsperson.clock: Wages are due within 15 days of the work
mgnrega.ombudsperson.provision: MGNREG Act 2005 and state grievance rules
mgnrega.ombudsperson.after_gate: MGNREGA wages are due within 15 days, and delay past that carries compensation. Your district has an Ombudsperson who can pass an award.
mgnrega.ombudsperson.caveat: Thin in practice — as of 2018 only 20 states and one Union Territory had even framed MGNREGA grievance rules, and unemployment allowance actually paid nationally was ₹12,000 and ₹3,000 in 2019-20 and 2020-21.

pothole.compensation.title: Public-law compensation for injury
pothole.compensation.forum: Civic body and road contractor, jointly
pothole.compensation.where: Claim against the civic body; recoverable from the officers and contractors named
pothole.compensation.teeth: ₹6 lakh for a death; ₹50,000 to ₹2.5 lakh for injury
pothole.compensation.clock: Arises when the road caused a death or injury
pothole.compensation.provision: Article 21; High Court on Its Own Motion v. State of Maharashtra, Bombay HC, 14 October 2025
pothole.compensation.after_gate: If this road caused a death or an injury, the Bombay High Court fixed compensation in October 2025 — ₹6 lakh for a death, ₹50,000 to ₹2.5 lakh for injury — payable by the civic body and the contractor jointly, and recoverable from the officers named.
pothole.compensation.scope: Maharashtra. Kerala has held similarly. Elsewhere the Article 21 reasoning is available but the amounts are not fixed.

consumer.commission.title: Consumer Commission
consumer.commission.teeth: Refund, replacement, compensation for loss and harassment. District up to ₹50 lakh; State up to ₹2 crore
consumer.commission.clock: No 21-day cap; it is a filing, not a request
consumer.commission.after_gate: Deficient service by any provider can go to a District Consumer Commission through e-Daakhil, which can order refund and compensation.

telecom.consumer_commission.title: Consumer Commission (no telecom ombudsman exists)
telecom.consumer_commission.forum: Operator appellate authority, then a Consumer Commission
telecom.consumer_commission.teeth: Damages are only available at a Consumer Commission — telecom has no ombudsman
telecom.consumer_commission.clock: 30 days for non-billing complaints inside the operator
telecom.consumer_commission.after_gate: Telecom has no ombudsman. Your operator has a two-tier mechanism, and damages are only available at a Consumer Commission.

pmkisan.escalation.title: Goes up to the senior state officer
pmkisan.escalation.where: pmkisan.gov.in, then the State Nodal Officer
pmkisan.escalation.teeth: Goes up on its own after 15 working days
pmkisan.escalation.provision: Scheme guidelines, Ministry of Agriculture and Farmers Welfare
pmkisan.escalation.after_gate: Land seeding and name-mismatch cases escalate automatically to your State Nodal Officer after 15 working days.

service.rts_act.title: Right to service, if your state has one
service.rts_act.forum: Your state’s right-to-service law, where it has one
service.rts_act.where: The designated officer, then the appellate authority named in the Act
service.rts_act.teeth: Bihar: the officer has court-like powers and 60 working days. Rajasthan: ₹250 for every day late, up to ₹5,000. Karnataka: ₹20 a day paid to you, up to ₹500
service.rts_act.clock: Set by the state Act, not by the 21-day administrative target
service.rts_act.provision: State legislation — MP 2010, Rajasthan 2011, Karnataka Sakala 2011, Delhi 2011, Bihar 2015 and others
service.rts_act.after_gate: CPGRAMS runs on an Office Memorandum, not a statute — the 21-day target carries no penalty. If your state has a right-to-service Act, the clock there has legal teeth.
service.rts_act.caveat: Only some states have such an Act. Where none exists, escalation is persuasion, and we say so.
